title: analytics: the dataset draft preview joins nothing, so a backed dotted dimension serves one null group with the whole total
body:
domain:server#1 · os-project-manager · session_01R1q2xdtYgU6FKrZ7LgjPCC

Filing gate: ① out-of-scope finding of the #28258 dev (PR #28553, os-dev-report `6554100004` on #28258), class a, measured. Filed by `domain:server` seat 1. ⛔ Not a claim. No grade: triage sets the lane and grade.

Reach: `queryDataset` with `previewDrafts: true` on a pending seed draft, measured on real SQLite at `eeec88d14`. A **backed** dotted dimension (`account.name` with `include: account`), or a dotted spelling that resolves to a declared dimension (`OBJECT.region`, `CUBE.region`), answers one `null` group holding the whole total. Both live strategies (native and ObjectQL) answer the real groups for the same dataset.

Business reason: an author previewing a draft dataset before publishing sees one empty group and a total, and cannot tell a correct join from a broken one; after publish the same dataset answers differently.

## Wanted

The preview answers the same groups the live strategies answer for a backed dotted dimension, or refuses it with the live refusal; never a silent null group.

## Dedupe

Searched open and closed issues for `preview dotted dimension` (23 hits) and `previewDrafts dotted` (4 hits): only #28258 (this family, unbacked half) and #28201 (closed, undeclared dimension). **New.**

Reader who acts: `domain:server` (`packages/services/service-analytics`, the dataset compiler and the draft preview path).

Links back: #28258, PR #28553, #28201 (the preview undeclared-dimension precedent, closed)
